title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Gambler
desc: Inspector Dayashanker, though lazy, accidentally uncovers a big criminal plot and suddenly becomes a hero in his department. But angry gangsters make his life a nightmare.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Ajay
desc: Ajay decent man from middleclass family,finds his whole family murdered.He decides to work for Rupesh,a criminal.While working with him,Ajay finds a clue leading him to the killer.

title: Gulaal
desc: Dilip, a law student from Rajpur, is assaulted by Jadhwal's gang. Seeking revenge, he becomes entangled in the dark and dangerous world of politics.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Kudrat
desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and realizes she was Paro in a past life. Seeking justice for her tragic past, she sets out to confront those responsible.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Judgementall Hai Kya
desc: Bobby, a dubbing artist with a troubled past, rents part of her home to Keshav and Rima. But her dark memories return as she grows wary and starts spying on Keshav.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das managed India's hockey team after independence. He faces many challenges as he fights to lead the team to win an Olympic gold medal for the nation.

title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
